Methylierungsdaten laden
```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(wd, '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

Einführung der 7 diagnostischen CpGs
```{r}
#Creating vector with the 7 CpGs in BRCA diagnostics
cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis <- c("cg20383521", "cg09804858", "cg06741896", "cg01668352", "cg10708955","cg06998282", "cg04658021")

```

```{r}
# Checking if the 7 CpGs are contained in the original dataframe
cpgs_present <- cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis %in% rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original)

print(cpgs_present)
```

```{r}
#Creating data frame for 7 BRCA diagnostic CpGs
cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis_data <- BRCA_methylation_data_original[rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original) %in% cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis, ]

print(cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis_data)
```

DMA Ergebnisse laden
```{r}
#laden der DMP csv Datei (CpG_overlap)
wd <- getwd()
data_path_2 <- paste0(wd, '/data/CpG_overlap.csv')
Top_ranking_CpGs <- read.csv(data_path_2)
```

```{r}
cpgs_present_DMA <- cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis %in% Top_ranking_CpGs$Name

print(cpgs_present_DMA)
```
```{r}
# Filtern der Top_ranking_CpGs für die in cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis vorhandenen CpGs
filtered_CpGs <- Top_ranking_CpGs[Top_ranking_CpGs$Name %in% cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis, ]

# Drucken der gefilterten Tabelle
print(filtered_CpGs)
```



Annotation sheet laden
```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(wd, '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
#identical naming of the patient ID 
colnames(cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis_data) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis_data))
```

```{r}
#Subset of annotation data frame to Type
tissue_types <- BRCA_sample_sheet[,7, drop=FALSE]
print(tissue_types)
```

```{r}
#diagnostic BRCA cpgs for spesific tissue
healthy_patients <- cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis_data[,BRCA_sample_sheet$Type == 'Solid Tissue Normal'] 
healthy_patients
```

```{r}
tumor_patients <- cpgs_for_BRCA_diagnosis_data[,BRCA_sample_sheet$Type == 'Primary solid Tumor'] 
print(tumor_patients)
```

```{r}
install.packages("ggpubr")
install.packages("ggplot")
install.packages("reshape22")
```


```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(ggpubr)

# Creating long format for violinplot 
healthy_long <- melt(as.matrix(healthy_patients), varnames = c("CpG", "PatientID"), value.name = "Methylation")
healthy_long$Status <- 'Solid Tissue Normal'

tumor_long <- melt(as.matrix(tumor_patients), varnames = c("CpG", "PatientID"), value.name = "Methylation")
tumor_long$Status <- 'Primary solid Tumor'

# combine both long formats
combined_data <- rbind(healthy_long, tumor_long)
print(combined_data)
```




```{r}
# Merge, um adjustierte p-Werte hinzuzufügen
combined_data3 <- merge(combined_data, filtered_CpGs, by.x = "CpG", by.y = "Name", all.x = TRUE)

# Überprüfen der kombinierten Daten
print(combined_data3)

```
```{r}
display_significance <- function(p_values) {
  significance <- ifelse(p_values < 0.001, "***", 
                         ifelse(p_values < 0.01, "**", 
                                ifelse(p_values < 0.05, "*", "")))
  return(significance)
}

# Definieren der Reihenfolge der CpGs für die Darstellung im Plot
combined_data3$CpG <- factor(combined_data$CpG, levels = unique(combined_data$CpG))

# Definieren Sie Status als Faktor mit gewünschter Reihenfolge der Levels
combined_data3$Status <- factor(combined_data$Status, levels = c("Solid Tissue Normal", "Primary solid Tumor"))

# Erstellen des Boxplots mit Signifikanzsymbolen
library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(combined_data3, aes(x = CpG, y = Methylation, fill = factor(Status))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = "black", outlier.size = 1, width = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "red")) +
  labs(x = "CpG sites", y = "beta value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.margin = margin(25, 25, 25, 25)
  ) +
  geom_text(data = subset(combined_data3, !duplicated(CpG)), 
            aes(label = display_significance(adj.P.Val.x), y = max(Methylation, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05), 
            color = "black", size = 7, vjust = -0.5, 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.5))

# Plot anzeigen
print(p)
ggsave("Literatur_comparison_Boxplot_7_CpGs_after_DMA.pdf",plot = p, width = 20, height = 8)
```
